title: Afɔrebɔ a Ɛsakraa Nkrabea
intro: Wɔ adesamma mfiase no, ɔkra bi de akyɛde bi ma a na ɔwɔ adwempa. Nanso, na ahoɔyaw ahintaw wɔ gye a wogye tom no sunsuma mu. Hwehwɛ saa onipa yi a ne nyamesom pa ne n’awiei a ɛyɛ awerɛhow no ayɛ nea enwu da wɔ ɔsoro adiyisɛm mu no ho asɛm.
clues: Ná meka adesamma awo ntoatoaso a edi kan koraa no ho.
Mede afɔrebɔ ma m’Awurade, na wɔde adom gyee no.
Wɔpoo me nua no afɔrebɔ no, na ahoɔyaw maa ne koma yɛɛ sum.
Meka kyerɛɛ no ​​sɛ, ‘Sɛ woteɛ wo nsa kyerɛ me sɛ wobɛkum me a, merentene me nsa ankum wo; ampa ara se mesuro Allah, ewiase nyinaa Awurade.'
Mebɛyɛɛ obi a wodii awudisɛm a edi kan wɔ asase so.
Me mogya teɛɛm, na me ne obi a odi kan a owui sɛ me ho nni asɛm.

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
